tldr: For every fixed public overlap \(\epsilon\in(0,1/2)\) and decay exponent \(b>0\), the known-uniform latent table class is observed through a supplied treatment-only binary symmetric channel with reliability \(\eta_d=[\log(\mathrm e d)]^{-b}\). With exactly \(d\) original records and unrestricted binary outcome means, the leading logarithmic minimax MSE constant is \(\kappa(\epsilon,b)=2\log\rho_\epsilon/(1+2b)\), where \(\rho_\epsilon=(1+2\sqrt{\epsilon(1-\epsilon)})/(1-2\epsilon)\). Reciprocal approximation and a signed distinct-record lift supply original-record attainment; normalized moment priors and the complete marked-cell likelihood supply the matching converse against all randomized rules. At \(\epsilon=1/4\), \(\rho_\epsilon=2+\sqrt3\). The public reciprocal-obstruction and approximation methods are credited.
gap: The clean known-uniform reciprocal obstruction and the credited clean critical theorem do not evaluate the degree-dependent cost of a public vanishing treatment channel. Regular annotation efficiency addresses different nuisance and labeling conditions.
fill: An explicit \(\kappa(b)\), an attaining statistic on exactly \(d\) original records, and a matching full-record converse quantify the leading precision loss. Certified rational evaluation makes attainment a total procedure under effective public inputs.
